executiveSummary: Multiple authoritative advisories confirm active targeting of industrial controllers and OT environments. U.S. agencies report Iranian-affiliated actors exploiting internet-exposed PLCs (Rockwell/Schneider/Siemens/Unitronics), manipulating logic and HMI displays across Water/Wastewater, Energy, and Government facilities. Security Advisory A separate joint advisory warns of AI-assisted reconnaissance and exploitation against Siemens S7-series PLCs with S7comm tooling, underscoring near-term risk to engineering workstations and controllers if segmentation and access controls are weak. Security Advisory High-impact vendor advisories affect core grid and plant controls: Hitachi Energy FACTS Control Platform (FCP) GWS web-layer flaws could enable unauthorized parameter changes impacting transmission stability; Mitsubishi Electric's CC-Link IE TSN protocol-level integrity issue has no fix and permits on-segment tampering/DoS; and GX Works3 authentication bypass enables covert PLC program modification. Security Advisory Security Advisory Security Advisory Perimeter device exploitation remains a primary ingress: pre-auth RCE in NetScaler ADC/Gateway (CVE-2026-8452) with public PoC, multiple KEV additions (Citrix, Cisco, Fortinet, Linux kernel), and active MikroTik RouterOS exploitation chains enabling full router takeover and lateral movement toward OT networks. Security Advisory KEV Update Advisory Additional OT-relevant risks include Danfoss iC7 industrial drives allowing unsigned applications/firmware uploads, and ransomware activity (Gunra) leveraging edge VPN/firewall appliances for enterprise compromise with potential IT-to-OT pivot. CISA Bulletin #StopRansomware Adversary use of compromised routers/IoT devices for covert networks (FSB Center 16; PRC-nexus Volt/Flax Typhoon) and pro-Russia hacktivist brute-forcing of VNC-exposed HMIs continue to threaten OT perimeters. outlook72h: Freeze and validate external exposure: confirm no PLC/HMI or engineering tools are reachable from the internet; close or broker any residual access immediately. Rapid patch cycle: NetScaler ADC/Gateway, MikroTik RouterOS, Cisco ISE/SEG, Check Point Management, Fortinet SSL-VPN; validate with compromise assessments per KEV guidance. OT integrity checks: compare PLC logic to golden baselines in critical processes; review recent downloads/online edits; verify HMI alarm states and historian data paths. Segment and monitor: ensure OT DMZ policy enforcement; deploy/retune ICS IDS for S7comm/CIP/Modbus write detections; alert on unusual TCP/102/502/44818. Backups & recovery: confirm offline, tested backups for HMIs/engineering workstations, PLC/drive configurations; stage recovery media. Brief operations and vendors: communicate active threats and change windows; coordinate vendor remote access via time-bound, recorded sessions with MFA.
